Example 16: ThreadPool (Web Workers)

Web Workers (ThreadPool) vs Main Thread Blocking

Multithreading Test

Watch the spinning cubes. Clicking the Main Thread button will completely freeze the browser (0 FPS) while calculating 5,000,000 primes.

The Worker Pool button offloads the exact same calculation to a background thread, keeping the engine running butter-smooth.
